facts.fact: The 2026 budget law (Mapa VII) appropriates CVE 290,706,686 to the Sistema de Informação para o Desenvolvimento Sustentável programme, all from the treasury with no external financing in the law; the programme is a national statistical information system, so its scope as a digital line is partial.
facts.system: Sistema de Informação para o Desenvolvimento Sustentável programme, 2026

facts.fact: The programme's domestic appropriation is CVE 290,706,686 for 2026 against CVE 302,771,454 for 2025, a fall, per the record's own note on the three-year series.
facts.system: Sistema de Informação para o Desenvolvimento Sustentável programme, 2026

note: Q1 2026 execution (CVE 60,549,143 at 31 March) is a quarter-year figure, not a spent fact; loans reprogrammed in at Q1 are external and give no fact.
